notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Made a few changes to the system.

Added a monster type to make level 1 a little easier on new players.

Fixed a bug where the crystal in level 5 sends you to the outside of level 4.

Fixing the cure sprite to not show pink background.

Have fun everyone!
